Imported is static discovery, not runtime application. Status `used (optional)` means an actual emitting route exists and was exercised on the named evidence; it is disabled by default where performance support is incomplete. Unexplored combinations remain `?`. Source/library recipes and exact pins live under `../artifacts/experiments/`; checkpoint042 retains original physical results, checkpoint043 retains the new column readout comparison. New movement row/contiguous and LHS band adapters are connected to the common encoder with explicit options, not inferred from imports.

Current additions: packed-K transport and geometry full-K retention are actual emitting alternatives (integration054); bounded M1 segmented projection reuses the same checked owners (integration055). All remain off pending complete paired timing. Source-owner CPU fusion is selected with actual host/ELF application and15.60% modeled connected-region gain (host_owner_fusion051, promotion053). New source preparation and dense-input-view requests yielded unchanged complete cycles (source_preparation054, dense_input_views054).

Checkpoint069 integration status: source-axis affine radix simplification is an actual optional convolution address-emitter path (integration069/index_strength069/products.json, full LLVM effect traces); it changes no target command/fence sequence. Dense aligned M16/raw RHS rectangle coalescing consumes panel_tile_loads plus the exact concrete effect/completion join on the incumbent checked epochs; integration069/epoch_coalescing069/products.json and parent_review.json prove actual emission. Both new choices are off pending complete paired cycles. Bounded M1 decode coalescing is selected after promotion068 complete modeled comparisons and two fresh original gSIM passes. Materialized source-row packing and exact preparation-view elimination are actual optional emitting paths, but are not selected: integration067 runtime storage admission remains unresolved. They confer no independent runtime correctness credit.

Checkpoint070: aligned M16 raw RHS coalescing is now used (selected) after paired complete provisional -29.58%/-29.61% output/down projections with unchanged source predicate and controls. Full original-standalone byte comparison versus068 has no extra changes. No measured speedup or broader N crossover claim.
